units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:7:4">Y. Erub. I, 19ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>זכרותו של ק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00471"><he>זַכְרוּת</he></cite>.

R. Hash. III, 2 כל השופרות … ק׳ all shofars (horns) are fit for use on the New Year’s day, except that of a cow, because it is called ḳeren (and not shofar); והלא כל … ק׳ do not all shofars also go by the name of ḳeren? Ib. 26ᵃ; a. v. fr.—
Keth. XIII, 2, v. צְבִי.—Esp. (sub. נזק) damage done by an animal’s horn, goring.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 2b:17">B. Kam. 2ᵇ</cite>.
Ib. 4ᵃ; a. fr.—Trnsf. horn, trump, wind instrument.
Kel. XI, 7 ק׳ עגולה a round (wound) metal horn; contrad. to פשוטה a plain (straight) horn; Sabb. 47ᵃ; a. fr.—Du. קַרְנַיִם, קַרְנַיִים, קַרְנַיִין; pl. קְרָנִים, קְרָנִין, קְרָנוֹת.
<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 2:1">Tosef. Par. II (I), 2</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 44a:22">Bekh. 44ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 2:2">Par. II, 2</cite> <he>פרה שקַרְנֶיהָ וכ׳</he> a red cow whose horns and hoofs are black; Bekh. l. c. <he>שקרנים וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Chullin 60a:7">Ḥull. 60ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>שור … קְרָנָיו קודמות וכ׳</he> the ox which Adam sacrificed was born with his horns (full grown) in advance of his hoofs.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 12:9">Par. XII, 9</cite> <he>ק׳ של יוצאי דרכים</he> the travellers’ drinking horns.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99:2">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> <he>אלו תוקעי ק׳ וכ׳</he> these (the Levites) blow horns, and those (the Greeks) blow trumpets.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99:2">Ib.</cite> <he>זה בעל ק׳ וזה בעל ק׳</he> this one (Joseph) is described as endowed with horns (power, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:17">Deut. XXXIII, 17</cite>), and that one (Rome) is &c. (<cite ref="Daniel 7:24">Dan. VII, 24</cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:2:3">Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>כקַרְנֵי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00539"><he>כִּילּוּיָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:2:3">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 77b:17">Yoma 77ᵇ</cite> <he>קרני חגבים</he> the antennæ of locusts; a. fr.
Ex. R. s. 47; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 37 קרני ההוד the beams of glory, halo; a. e.—

units: Nidd. II, 6, v. כַּרְכּוֹם I.—Esp. principal, capital.

B. Kam. IX, 7 משלם ק׳ וחומש וכ׳ must pay the principal (the full value of the stolen goods) and the fine of one-fifth, and bring a guilt-offering; a. v. fr.—Trnsf. the capital of reward or punishment laid aside for the hereafter.
